SELECT date_part('year', date_taken) AS year, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM jwst_space_images
WHERE date_part('year', date_taken) BETWEEN 2022 AND 2026
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT date_taken
  FROM jwst_space_images
  WHERE date_taken >= TIMESTAMP '2022-07-12'
    AND date_taken < TIMESTAMP '2027-01-01'
),
flagged AS (
  SELECT date_taken,
         CASE WHEN date_taken - LAG(date_taken) OVER (ORDER BY date_taken) > INTERVAL '168 hours'
                OR LAG(date_taken) OVER (ORDER BY date_taken) IS NULL
              THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_burst
  FROM ordered
),
bursts AS (
  SELECT date_taken,
         SUM(new_burst) OVER (ORDER BY date_taken ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
  FROM flagged
),
sizes AS (
  SELECT burst_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM bursts GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_bursts, MAX(n) AS largest_burst_size FROM sizes
SELECT COUNT(*) AS nebula_count FROM jwst_space_images WHERE subject = 'nebula'

WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT photo_id, subject, date_taken
  FROM jwst_space_images
  WHERE date_taken >= TIMESTAMP '2022-07-12'
    AND date_taken < TIMESTAMP '2027-01-01'
),
flagged AS (
  SELECT photo_id, subject, date_taken,
         CASE WHEN date_taken - LAG(date_taken) OVER (ORDER BY date_taken) > INTERVAL '168 hours'
                OR LAG(date_taken) OVER (ORDER BY date_taken) IS NULL
              THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_burst
  FROM ordered
),
bursts AS (
  SELECT photo_id, subject, date_taken,
         SUM(new_burst) OVER (ORDER BY date_taken ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
  FROM flagged
),
sizes AS (
  SELECT burst_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM bursts GROUP BY 1
),
largest AS (
  SELECT burst_id FROM sizes WHERE n = (SELECT MAX(n) FROM sizes)
),
burst_images AS (
  SELECT subject, date_taken FROM bursts b JOIN largest l ON b.burst_id = l.burst_id
),
subject_counts AS (
  SELECT subject, COUNT(*) AS subject_count
  FROM burst_images GROUP BY 1
),
top_subject AS (
  SELECT subject, subject_count FROM subject_counts
  WHERE subject_count = (SELECT MAX(subject_count) FROM subject_counts)
)
SELECT (SELECT MIN(date_taken) FROM burst_images) AS start_date,
       (SELECT MAX(date_taken) FROM burst_images) AS end_date,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM burst_images) AS image_count,
       subject,
       subject_count
FROM top_subject

WITH webb AS (
  SELECT instrument, subject
  FROM jwst_space_images
  WHERE instrument IN ('NIRCam', 'MIRI', 'NIRSpec', 'NIRISS', 'FGS')
),
counts AS (
  SELECT instrument, subject, COUNT(*) AS n FROM webb GROUP BY instrument, subject
),
totals AS (
  SELECT instrument, SUM(n) AS total FROM counts GROUP BY instrument
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT c.instrument, c.subject, c.n, t.total,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.instrument ORDER BY c.n DESC, c.subject) AS rn
  FROM counts c JOIN totals t USING (instrument)
)
SELECT instrument, subject,
       ROUND(100.0 * n / total, 1) AS percentage
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 2 AND total >= 20
ORDER BY total DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS nirspec_images FROM jwst_space_images WHERE instrument = 'NIRSpec'

WITH img AS (
  SELECT instrument, date_taken
  FROM jwst_space_images
  WHERE instrument IN ('NIRCam','MIRI','NIRSpec')
    AND date_taken >= TIMESTAMP '2022-07-12'
    AND date_taken <= CURRENT_DATE
),
ordered AS (
  SELECT instrument, date_taken,
         LAG(date_taken) OVER (PARTITION BY instrument ORDER BY date_taken) AS prev_date
  FROM img
),
gaps AS (
  SELECT instrument, date_taken AS end_date,
         date_diff('day', prev_date, date_taken) AS gap_days
  FROM ordered
  WHERE prev_date IS NOT NULL
),
max_gaps AS (
  SELECT instrument, MAX(gap_days) AS max_gap
  FROM gaps GROUP BY instrument
)
SELECT g.instrument, g.gap_days AS longest_gap_days, CAST(g.end_date AS DATE) AS gap_end_date,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN i.modality = 'spectrum_or_plot' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_spectra_or_plots
FROM gaps g
JOIN max_gaps m ON g.instrument = m.instrument AND g.gap_days = m.max_gap
JOIN jwst_space_images i ON i.instrument = g.instrument
GROUP BY g.instrument, g.gap_days, g.end_date
ORDER BY g.instrument

WITH lab AS (
  SELECT l.photo_id, l.gate_category, YEAR(p.date_taken) AS yr
  FROM labels l JOIN photos p ON l.photo_id = p.photo_id
  WHERE YEAR(p.date_taken) BETWEEN 2022 AND 2025
),
excl AS (
  SELECT a.* FROM lab a
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jwst_space_images j WHERE j.photo_id = a.photo_id)
)
SELECT yr,
       COUNT(*) AS labelled_count,
       ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM excl WHERE excl.yr = lab.yr) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_not_published,
       (SELECT gate_category FROM excl WHERE excl.yr = lab.yr GROUP BY gate_category ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) AS most_common_excluded_gate
FROM lab
GROUP BY yr
ORDER BY yr

SELECT object_name_normalized AS object, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM jwst_space_images
WHERE object_name_normalized IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(object_name_normalized) <> ''
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY count DESC, object
LIMIT 5

WITH valid AS (
  SELECT * FROM jwst_space_images
  WHERE object_name_normalized IS NOT NULL
    AND date_taken IS NOT NULL
    AND date_taken <= '2026-10-05'
),
spans AS (
  SELECT object_name_normalized AS object,
         COUNT(*) AS image_count,
         MIN(date_taken) AS first_date,
         MAX(date_taken) AS last_date,
         DATE_DIFF('day', MIN(date_taken), MAX(date_taken)) AS span_days
  FROM valid
  GROUP BY 1
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 4
)
SELECT object, image_count, first_date, last_date, span_days
FROM spans
ORDER BY span_days DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS pillar_images
FROM jwst_space_images
WHERE object_name_normalized = 'Pillars of Creation'

WITH per_object AS (
  SELECT object_name_normalized AS object,
         COUNT(*) AS image_count,
         COUNT(DISTINCT YEAR(date_taken)) AS distinct_years,
         MIN(YEAR(date_taken)) AS first_year,
         MAX(YEAR(date_taken)) AS last_year,
         100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (
           WHERE instrument IN ('NIRCam','MIRI','NIRSpec','NIRISS','FGS')
         ) / COUNT(*) AS single_instrument_pct
  FROM jwst_space_images
  WHERE object_name_normalized IS NOT NULL
    AND date_taken IS NOT NULL
    AND date_taken <= '2026-10-05'
  GROUP BY 1
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT YEAR(date_taken)) >= 3
)
SELECT object, image_count, first_year, last_year,
       ROUND(single_instrument_pct, 1) AS single_instrument_pct
FROM per_object
ORDER BY image_count DESC, object
